messages.subject: Tweaking box plot design
parts:
Hi,

Is it possible to manually change the design of the individual
components of a box plot? For example, give different line types/
colors to the median, quantiles, the line that goes to the min/max,
and add a notch to that line.

I know its possible to tweak the design of outliers, so I thought
maybe... :)

Thanks!
Shai

messages.author: 065110cca96a6373
messages.subject: Re: Tweaking box plot design
parts:
Hi,

I did not see any built-in functionality for this. I kind of like
simple boxplots (maybe with jittered points added), but maybe I'm old
fashioned. Anyway, it is not terribly difficult to add. An example
follows. You can see where all the options go, so if you wanted to
have different colour and style for each, just keep adding arguments
and pass them on.

Cheers,

Josh


# Data
dat <- data.frame(x = 1, y = c(1, 3, 5, 4, 5, 5, 10, 15))
# Default possibilities
ggplot(data = dat, aes(x = x, y = y)) + geom_boxplot(fill = "black",
colour = "maroon", lwd = 2)

# add another argument for the median line colour
GeomBoxplot$draw <- function(., data, ..., outlier.colour = "black",
outlier.shape = 16, outlier.size = 2, midcol = NULL) {
defaults <- with(data, data.frame(
x = x, xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax,
colour = colour, size = size,
linetype = 1, group = 1, alpha = 1,
fill = alpha(fill, alpha),
stringsAsFactors = FALSE
))
defaults2 <- defaults[c(1,1), ]
defaults3 <- defaults
if(is.null(midcol)) {midcol <- defaults[, "colour"]}
defaults3[, "colour"] <- midcol

if (!is.null(data$outliers) && length(data$outliers[[1]] >= 1)) {
outliers_grob <- with(data,
GeomPoint$draw(data.frame(
y = outliers[[1]], x = x[rep(1, length(outliers[[1]]))],
colour=I(outlier.colour), shape = outlier.shape, alpha = 1,
size = outlier.size, fill = NA), ...
)
)
} else {
outliers_grob <- NULL
}

with(data, ggname(.$my_name(), grobTree(
outliers_grob,
GeomPath$draw(data.frame(y=c(upper, ymax), defaults2), ...),
GeomPath$draw(data.frame(y=c(lower, ymin), defaults2), ...),
GeomRect$draw(data.frame(ymax = upper, ymin = lower, defaults), ...),
GeomRect$draw(data.frame(ymax = middle, ymin = middle, defaults3), ...)
)))
}

# Different colours
ggplot(data = dat, aes(x = x, y = y)) + geom_boxplot(fill = "black",
colour = "maroon", lwd = 2, midcol = "white"
